# Example 16

## Example 16


\begin{oltableau}
    [\sFmla{\False}{1, p \land  q}, checked, just = \TAss
        [\sFmla{\False}{1, p}, just = {\TRule{\False}{\land}[1]}
            [\sFmla{\True}{1, p}
                [\sFmla{\True}{1, p}
                    [\sFmla{\True}{1, q}]
                ]
            ]
        ]
        [\sFmla{\False}{1, q}, just = {\TRule{\False}{\land}[1]}
            [\sFmla{\True}{1, q}, move by = 2]
        ]
    ]
\end{oltableau}
